classic-1.9.15/plain:
set -eu
IFS= read -r SUDO_PASS || true
TMP=$(mktemp)
OLD=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$TMP" "$OLD"' EXIT
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$TMP"
printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' visudo -c -f "$TMP"
printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' install -o root -g root -m '0440' "$TMP" '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola'
printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' cat '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola'
printf '%s\n' 'KELOLA_SUDOERS_OK'
unset SUDO_PASS
classic-1.9.15/retire+journal:
set -eu
IFS= read -r SUDO_PASS || true
TMP=$(mktemp)
OLD=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$TMP" "$OLD"' EXIT
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$TMP"
RETIRE=0
if printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' test -f '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola-units'; then
  printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' cat '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola-units' > "$OLD"
  RETIRE=1
  while IFS= read -r l || [ -n "$l" ]; do
    case "$l" in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
    if printf '%s\n' "$l" | grep -Eqx -- 'hendr ALL=\(root\) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl (start|stop|restart|reload) [a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9_.@-]|\\:)*'; then
      grep -qxF -- "$l" "$TMP" || printf '%s\n' "$l" >> "$TMP"
    else
      RETIRE=0
    fi
  done < "$OLD"
fi
printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' visudo -c -f "$TMP"
printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' install -o root -g root -m '0440' "$TMP" '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola'
printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' cat '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola'
printf '%s\n' 'KELOLA_SUDOERS_OK'
if [ "$RETIRE" = 1 ] && printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' rm -f -- '/etc/sudoers.d/kelola-units'; then
  printf '%s\n' 'KELOLA_UNITS_RETIRED'
fi
if ! getent group systemd-journal >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\n' 'KELOLA_JOURNAL_GROUP=nogroup'
elif id -nG 'hendr' 2>/dev/null | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qx systemd-journal; then
  printf '%s\n' 'KELOLA_JOURNAL_GROUP=member'
elif printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' usermod -aG systemd-journal 'hendr'; then
  printf '%s\n' 'KELOLA_JOURNAL_GROUP=added'
else
  printf '%s\n' 'KELOLA_JOURNAL_GROUP=failed'
fi
unset SUDO_PASS
